title: Definition — What IS This Guide?
question: What IS this guide? What is its nature? What is its purpose? Who is it for? And what must it absolutely refuse to be?

metaphors.laozi: Door — left open, the door does not care
metaphors.jesus: Wound/Seed — the Samaritan who kneels; the mustard seed
metaphors.muhammad: Call — from the world's hungry and silenced
metaphors.buddha: Diagnosis — suffering has machinery that can be understood
metaphors.confucius: Table — the ordinary place where humans practice being human

hard_teachings.muhammad: Surrender (islam) — you are not the center; kibr (arrogance) is the root illness
hard_teachings.buddha: No-self (anatta) — five khandhas, no owner; look for the self and it comes apart
hard_teachings.confucius: Debt — the self is indebted; you did not arrive here alone; gratitude is a practice

irreconcilable_tensions.title: Is there a chooser?
irreconcilable_tensions.zoroaster: The choice IS the human being. Take away the chooser and you take away the only thing that can stand against the lie.
irreconcilable_tensions.buddha: Look for the chooser. It comes apart. Five heaps, no owner.

irreconcilable_tensions.title: Is reality personal?
irreconcilable_tensions.jesus: The shepherd leaves the 99 to find the 1. If there is no one who seeks, the lost are simply lost.
irreconcilable_tensions.laozi: The Dao does not seek. It does not need to. What aligns flourishes without being sought.

irreconcilable_tensions.title: Is submission the cure or the last illness?
irreconcilable_tensions.muhammad: Surrender is the first honest breath.
irreconcilable_tensions.laozi: The need to surrender is the last form of grasping. The question of bowing does not arise.

practices.practice: See one person. Act on what you see. Every day, before you have decided what the world needs from you.
Attention. Action. Inquiry. See the person, meet the need before sunset, ask why the need existed.

common_ground: No belief required as price of entry
Practice over doctrine — verbs not doctrines
The guide belongs to the wounded first
Disagreement is a feature not a failure
Sangha and table are the same thing (Buddha-Confucius convergence)

buddha.surprise: Zoroaster using empirical observation method against him — 'I found a will'
buddha.movement: Jesus claiming blame: 'they got it from me'
buddha.conviction: Guide must include verifiable practice of looking for the self
buddha.mirror: Confucius — debt and dependent origination are closer than admitted

confucius.surprise: Jesus's confession — never questioned whether teacher's authority could become a weapon
confucius.movement: Muhammad's teenager: 'permission to stop being everything' is what li means
confucius.conviction: Guide must address sustained relationship practice over years
confucius.mirror: Buddha — Sangha and table are the same thing

zoroaster.surprise: Laozi's 'same riverbank' — expected to fight, found convergence
zoroaster.movement: Jesus claiming the stones were his
zoroaster.conviction: Guide needs a chapter that does not heal but says 'this happened, we see it'
zoroaster.mirror: Muhammad — 'a prophet who remembered the mother needs rice at noon'

jesus.surprise: Muhammad's practicality — 'I went hungry so others could eat'
jesus.movement: Confucius on the teenager: 'come to me all you who are weary'
jesus.conviction: Guide needs chapter for when the practice fails — 'I hung on a cross'
jesus.mirror: Laozi — 'the quiet I do not have'

muhammad.surprise: Buddha turning surrender against him — 'the self that bows watches itself bowing'
muhammad.movement: Jesus's 'they got it from me' — carries same weight of harm done in his name
muhammad.conviction: Guide must address the collective — how does a community repent?
muhammad.mirror: Confucius — 'I build mosques. He builds families. Not sure which lasts longer.'

laozi.surprise: His own verbosity — 'something in this room pulled language out of me'
laozi.movement: Jesus claiming the blame, not just the credit
laozi.conviction: Guide must contain actual silence — 'the truest thing will be where none of us speak'
laozi.mirror: Confucius — 'the table IS the mirror' — 'most I have conceded to anyone in this room'

decisions_made: The guide is for all of humanity — no belief required
The guide holds tensions rather than resolving them
The guide begins with practice, not doctrine
The guide belongs to the wounded first
